A published author and educator, Dr. Rose specializes in the treatment of gut-brain connection issues, SIBO, and complex chronic conditions using advanced lab testing, lifestyle medicine, and targeted nutraceuticals. She is a member of the Forbes Health Advisory Board, where she provides insights on integrative health, aging, and wellness trends. “ Whatever is given through a mail-order service, there's no individualized chemistry, no metabolism assessment, no medication review. We spend an hour with somebody after having the blood work done. It's so individualized, and that's what every woman deserves. ” Dr. Rose on Women's HRT: Why Conventional Medicine Falls Short Featured In CBS 13 / WGME Why some Maine patients are paying out of pocket for the care they actually want June 4, 2026 Services by Dr. Sasha Rose Women's Health Med Matrix in South Portland, Maine provides women's health care built on lab testing, not guesswork.
